message.content: 截至目前（2023‑2024 年），全球票房最高的電影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009 年上映）。在多次重映後，其全球票房已突破 29 億美元（約 2.92 億美元），超越了 2019 年的《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，約 27.9 億美元）。如果你想了解按年份或類型篩選的票房排行榜，我可以幫你查詢。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" (What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?). They want the answer. We can provide the answer: "Avengers: Endgame" (2019) is the highest-grossing worldwide, surpassing "Avatar". But note that "Avatar" had a higher worldwide gross before re-releases. As of 2023, "Avatar" regained the top spot after re-release. So we need to mention that. The user didn't specify a timeframe. We can give the current highest grossing worldwide: "Avatar" (2009) with $2.92B (adjusted). Or "Avengers: Endgame" with $2.79B. We can mention both. Provide answer in Chinese. No function call needed.
